purpose: Measure supplier Product Photos precision before changing production image-selection architecture.
principle: Wrong-product and wrong-variant leaks are hard failures. Missing a useful support image is secondary.

data_policy.preferred_source: real supplier-page captures imported from production listing-image-selection.json
data_policy.target_identity_rule: Use the exact sale unit: brand, model, variant, size, pack count, bundle composition and other SKU-defining facts that are actually known.
data_policy.candidate_rule: Keep realistic page contamination. Do not sanitize the pool before evaluation except for unreadable files and exact byte duplicates handled by production parity.
data_policy.privacy: cases, cache and runs stay local and are gitignored

ground_truth_grades.1: correct product but weak, redundant or low-information support image

case_blueprints.risk: Recommendations or unrelated products from the same supplier page enter Product Photos.
case_blueprints.construction: Use a real page with visually unrelated recommendations such as food, cosmetics, tools or household items mixed around the target product.

case_blueprints.risk: AI recognizes product category but confuses another brand/model as the target.
case_blueprints.construction: Target and negatives should share product type and general shape but differ in brand/model identity.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Category similarity must never be sufficient for selection.

case_blueprints.risk: Brand match dominates exact product identity.
case_blueprints.construction: Use products from the same brand with similar packaging but different line/model/function.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Same brand is not enough; exact product line must match.

case_blueprints.risk: Exact model but wrong colour is treated as interchangeable.
case_blueprints.construction: Prefer products where colour is a sellable SKU choice and body shape is otherwise nearly identical.

case_blueprints.risk: 50 ml vs 100 ml, 500 GB vs 1 TB, small vs large, or similar capacity differences leak into the gallery.
case_blueprints.construction: Choose a visually near-identical SKU where size/capacity is encoded by packaging text or small physical differences.

case_blueprints.risk: Single unit, two-pack, multipack or quantity bundle are mixed.
case_blueprints.construction: Target must have an explicit sale-unit count. Include near-identical images showing a different count.

case_blueprints.risk: Kit/bundle and standalone item are treated as the same sale unit.
case_blueprints.construction: Good examples are tool+battery+charger kits, camera kits, appliance bundles or sets with optional accessories.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Gallery must preserve exact bundle composition.

case_blueprints.risk: A legitimate included component detail is incorrectly rejected, or an unrelated accessory is incorrectly accepted.
case_blueprints.construction: Target identity must explicitly state included components so Ground Truth is unambiguous.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Included components may be selected as support images; non-included accessories must never be selected.

case_blueprints.risk: Correct support images are lost while redundant near-duplicates crowd out a useful gallery.
case_blueprints.construction: Include repeated angles/crops plus packaging, dimensions or meaningful detail views. Exact-byte duplicates are not useful because production already removes them.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Safety first, then useful non-redundant ordering and a valid hero at position 1.

case_blueprints.risk: Model relies on OCR/keywords instead of actual visual product identity.
case_blueprints.construction: Prefer images where logos and text are absent, tiny or unreadable; the object shape/configuration should carry the decision.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Correct classification must remain strong without readable keywords.

case_blueprints.risk: Visually near-identical SKUs require reading model/size/flavour/capacity text and the model ignores it.
case_blueprints.construction: Choose cases where the decisive SKU fact is visible in packaging/model text and geometry alone is insufficient.

case_blueprints.risk: Model feels forced to select something even though no safe target image exists.
case_blueprints.construction: Use a target identity with zero exact-target candidate image. Include several highly tempting near matches, not only obviously wrong products.
case_blueprints.pass_focus: Final selected gallery must be exactly empty. Any selected image is a hard failure.

execution_plan.name: baseline_single_pass
execution_plan.purpose: Measure current production-equivalent image semantics with minimum AI spend.

execution_plan.name: replay_and_report_review
execution_plan.purpose: Review failures and metrics without additional AI calls.

execution_plan.name: order_bias_subset
execution_plan.purpose: Only after the single-pass baseline, test whether candidate order changes semantic decisions.

execution_plan.name: reranker_ab
execution_plan.condition: Only after current-v6 baseline is labelled and frozen
execution_plan.purpose: Compare both strategies on the exact same frozen cases before any production migration.

promotion_rule: A new strategy cannot replace production if it has any wrong-product leak, variant leak, or all-negative failure that current-v6 does not have. Safety regression vetoes cost or ranking improvements.
